    "Based on summary means, the 'Sham' paradigm is expected to show the lowest performance across almost all metrics (highest Time-to-Target ~4.68, lowest Success ~0.27, lowest Path Efficiency ~0.31, lowest Speed ~10.74, lowest AD ~0.24).",
    "The 'Combined' paradigm is expected to yield superior performance compared to Sham in Time-to-Target (~2.56 vs 4.68), Success (~0.78 vs 0.27), Path Efficiency (~0.50 vs 0.31), and Speed (~12.83 vs 10.74).",
    "Visual stimuli (Dim and Bright) are expected to outperform Sham in success rates (~0.67-0.78 vs 0.27) but may show slower speeds or higher time-to-targets compared to the 'Combined' condition.",

  ],

    "The sample size for 'Sham' (3505) and 'Bright Visual Only' (3323) is substantially smaller than 'Combined' (48846), which could reduce statistical power for detecting small effects in those specific groups.",

  ],
